comments: Chosen assumptions: ego leads in a middle lane at 8-9 m/s and initiates a left lateral evasion after 2 s. Agent1 follows in the same lane, 18-20 m behind at 11-12 m/s, and reacts after 0.3-0.5 s by escaping right while ego is departing left. The interaction begins in the source lane; both flanking lanes must coexist. Ego is the initiator and agent1 the responder. Seven-second horizon; no collision is required.
